bio_en: Hambardzum Grigorian studied at the Atrpatakan diocesan central school under ARF leaders and became a teacher in Qazvin, where Rostom met and advised him in 1918. Settling in Tehran, he was one of the founders of the ARF daily Alik, launched on 21 March 1931, which became a daily in 1940. A music teacher and composer, he led an Armenian choir for four decades, honoured by both Persians and Armenians. He died in 1975 after nearly sixty years of service.
